profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at American Express
profile.summary: Software Developer skilled at technical leadership, communication and presentations. Experienced in full project life cycle from design to implementation to integration. Also, precisely executes development projects from concept to delivery.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: Datadog, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +4 skills

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Wrote an android mobile scanning application to replace legacy hardware which processes USPS mail through
UPS facilities in transit to other postal locations. Conducted functionality testing to verify seamless data
transfer on a new platform. The application is used in over 60 sites handling more than 70,000 scans a day.
● Developed an android mobile scanning application to replace legacy hardware used by all UPS hubs and sort
operations to capture location scans of packages in the UPS network.
● Developed a cloud solution to reduce the number of devices that a package sorter would need to perform
their job. The application will use OpenShift as a central service that would manage scanners across all UPS
facilities.
● Conducted full end-to-end system shakeout tests on multiple environments. The tests covered not only
software but also physical sorting processes such as scanning (with hardware), relinking, reprinting labels, and
package routing and bagging.
● Rapidly prototyped new scanning technology to confirm integration feasibility into existing systems.
● Collaborated effectively with members using Agile Scrum methodology including weekly manager meetings to
provide a detailed project report and milestone updates.
● Worked closely with Systems Engineering and vendors to design and develop a robust scanning solution to
meet UPS requirements for functionality, scalability and performance.

positions.title: Cyber Security Intern
positions.description:
Learning the Comodo product suite for border gateway protection, endpoint protection, web site protection, and security sensor integration. Security information and event management (SIEM), firewalls. 

Resolved SIEM tickets to determine verified false positives and reporting on the same. 

Data science activities to determine baseline normal network from anomalous behaviors. 

Wrote a technical paper on blockchain technology’s potential use-cases in cybersecurity.

Worked with other analysts in other parts of the world.

positions.title: Software Developer, Team Lead
positions.description:
Guided team development efforts towards successful project delivery. 

Provide technical leadership to teammates through coaching and mentorship. 

Maintain high standards of software quality within the team by establishing good practices and habits.
 
led planning , design, develop, and test phases, and maintains web applications built around Google technologies.

Take responsibility for making key decisions to ensure the successful implementation of all initiatives 
Prepared and led weekly meetings to discuss project milestones and how to reach them.

Implemented designs, including experimentation and multiple iterations.

Consulted regularly with customers on project status, proposals and technical issues.

Directed software design and development while remaining focused on client needs.

honors.description: 1st Place in the UPS Hackathon competition between 46 teams
